name: Galbrena

tierList.prydwen: T1 Tower of Adversity, T1.5 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Fusion Pistols main DPS built around 'Demon Hypostasis', an enhanced Basic Attack/Dodge Counter cleave stance entered via her enhanced Skill by spending Sinflame (max 100). Also holds a second Forte resource, Afterflame (max 40, replenished by teammates' Echo Skill casts), which raises enemy DMG Taken while in Demon Hypostasis by up to 60%.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack (Slayer's Trigger, up to 4 hits) / Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution (5 hits) in Demon Hypostasis - main Sinflame/Forte-consuming combo.
skills.resonanceSkill: Encroach - dash+leap Fusion strike; at 100 Sinflame becomes Ascent of Malice, which enters Demon Hypostasis.
skills.forte: Threshold State/Demon Hypostasis toggle governing Sinflame -> Purging Flame conversion and Afterflame stacking.
skills.liberation: Hellfire Absolution - Fusion hit, grants 85% DMG multiplier increase to her Demon Hypostasis kit for 14s.
skills.intro: Hellflare Overload - Fusion strike leading into Basic/Heavy Attack Stage 2.
skills.outro: Ashen Pursuit - pure damage Fusion hit, doesn't restrict quickswap.

bestWeapons: Static Mist (81.6%, standard 5-star, great in Mono Fusion)
echoSet: Flamewing's Shadow (100%, best - only she uses it well)
paired with Molten Rift/Flaming Clawprint/Trailblazing Star/Chromatic Foam (recommended), or Endless Resonance/Reel of Spliced Memories, or Moonlit Clouds/Empyrean Anthem/Tidebreaking Courage

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Qiuyuan and Lucilla are her best Echo-DMG buffers (fills Afterflame + amplifies Echo DMG).

teams.name: Mono Fusion Alternatives
teams.notes: Lupa enables a strong Mono Fusion archetype, especially in Whimpering Wastes.

rotation: Intro -> Basic 2,3,4 -> Basic 2,3 -> Enhanced Skill (Ascent of Malice, interrupt on hit) -> Ultimate -> Forte Basic 2,3,4,5 -> Forte Basic 3,4,5 (swap-cancel) -> Outro. Always cast active Echo before entering Demon Hypostasis to fill Afterflame; Dodge Counters replace weaker Basic hits whenever available.
communityNotes: Prydwen: best Fusion DPS currently in the game with wide teammate flexibility and no signature-weapon dependency; simple Basic-Attack-spam playstyle whose damage loads heavily into the back half of her rotation, hurting her multi-wave (Whimpering Wastes) value versus single-target Tower of Adversity performance. Competes closely with Changli for the Mono Fusion team slot.
